rules.title: Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate a tenancy without one of the listed just causes. Landlords must pay relocation assistance for no-fault evictions, such as owner or family move-in, demolition or removal from the rental market, or a government order to vacate.
rules.coverage_text: Most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles that are not regulated by the City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO). This includes buildings newer than October 1, 1978 and properties with only one single-family dwelling. It applies once the tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or the original lease has expired, whichever comes first.
rules.exemptions: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses and the owner's roommate. Also exempt: cooperatives under certain circumstances, some non-profit facilities for the homeless or short-term substance abuse treatment centers, and some properties owned by HACLA or the government. Units regulated by the RSO are not covered by the JCO.
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
rules.interaction_text: The JCO covers most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles that are not regulated by the City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).

rules.title: Evictions for Non-Payment of Rent threshold
rules.requirement: Landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes more than the Fair Market Rent (FMR). The FMR depends on the bedroom size of the unit.
rules.key_value: Amount owed must exceed the Fair Market Rent (FMR) for the unit's bedroom size
rules.coverage_text: All RSO and JCO rental units in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.citation: Evictions for Non-Payment of Rent (LAHD JCO page)
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR). The FMR depends on the bedroom size of the rental unit.

rules.title: Eviction Notices Filed with LAHD
rules.requirement: All eviction notices issued to tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three (3) business days of service on the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: All JCO and RSO rental properties in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.citation: Eviction Notices Filed with LAHD (LAHD JCO page)
rules.quoted_span: Applies to all JCO & RSO rental properties – All eviction notices issued to tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three (3) business days of service on the tenant.

rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act of 2019 (AB 1482) rent cap
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are limited to no more than 5% plus the percentage change in the regional cost of living, or 10%, whichever is lower. From August 1, 2024 to July 31, 2025 the maximum allowable increase is 8.9%.
rules.key_value: 5% plus the percentage change in the cost of living for the region, or 10%, whichever is lower
rules.coverage_text: Buildings older than 15 years, other than the listed exempt properties.
rules.exemptions: Units constructed within the last 15 years, on a rolling basis. Units deed- or regulatory-restricted as affordable to low or moderate-income households. Certain dormitories. Two-unit properties where an owner occupied the second unit for the entire tenancy. Single-family homes and condominiums not owned by a real estate trust, a corporation, or an LLC with at least one corporate member, where the landlord gave the tenant written notice of exemption; this does not apply if there is more than one dwelling unit on the lot or a non-separable second unit. Units already subject to the City's RSO.
rules.citation: AB 1482, the California Tenant Protection Act of 2019
rules.quoted_span: rent increases are limited to no more than 5% plus the percentage change in the cost of living for the region in which the property is located, or 10% whichever is lower).
rules.interaction_text: -Units that are already subject to the City’s RSO.
